lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8In4Cu4 (reduced formula Nd2InCu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and In each adopt tetrahedral environments with four Nd neighbors, while Nd centers have ten geometric neighbors (two Cu, two In, six Nd). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and between In tetrahedra.
